Definition: Chanan, the name of seven Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Canan or Hanan = "he is merciful"; 1) one of the chief people of the tribe of Benjamin; 2) last of the 6 sons of Azel, a descendant of Saul; 3) son of Maachah, one of David's mighty warriors; 4) father of some sons who returned from exile with Zerubbabel; 5) one of the Levites who assisted Ezra in his public exposition of the law; 6) one of the heads of the people who also sealed the covenant with Nehemiah; 7) another of the chief laymen who also sealed the covenant with Nehemiah; 8) son of Zaccur, grandson of Mattaniah whom Nehemiah made one of the storekeepers of the provisions collected as tithes. Same as 5?; 9) son of Igdaliah
